title: Deleting a carrier point from a zero-dimensional integer multiplicity triple
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0) (p : Euclid P), p ∈ R.carrier → ∃ R' : IMRep U 0, R'.carrier = R.carrier \ {p} ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient ∧ R.measure = R'.measure + (R.mult p : ℝ≥0∞) • Measure.dirac p ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) = R'.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) + (R.mult p : ℝ) * R.orient p ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) p)
